snippet.title: Captain Coco: Treasure Island | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #CaptainCocoTreasureIsland
🇧🇷🇵🇹
🏴‍☠️ Uma aventura tropical cheia de puzzles espera por você em Captain Coco: Treasure Island!
Junte-se a Captain Coco, um macaco pirata esperto, e explore ilhas misteriosas empurrando cocos para quebrar baús de tesouro. Cada fase é um novo desafio que exige planejamento, movimentos inteligentes e muita astúcia pirata!

🎮 Disponível a partir de 10 de novembro no Xbox, com 20% de desconto no lançamento!


🏴‍☠️ A tropical puzzle adventure awaits you in Captain Coco: Treasure Island!
Join Captain Coco, a clever pirate monkey, and explore mysterious islands by pushing coconuts to break treasure chests. Every level is a new challenge that requires careful planning, smart moves, and a bit of pirate cunning!

🎮 Available starting November 10 on Xbox, with a 20% launch discount!

KEY FEATURES
🥥 Push coconuts to break treasure chests;
🥥 Explore mysterious islands packed with clever puzzles;
🥥 Plan your moves and outsmart every challenge!

Grab Yours 
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/HV2rT
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/j23Z4
🎮 Windows: https://x.gd/EEJ3F
